canonical_nonprod_rule: Use synthetic/test data outside PROD unless a specific governed use case requires otherwise.

Controlled production validation records must be clearly named and retained/cleaned under evidence.
Secrets remain environment-specific and out of source control.
Production exports/backups require authorization and retention evidence.
